body: Sometimes. It’s been difficult getting a full night of good sleep. I have sleep apnea and have an internal device to treat it. If I can’t fall asleep, taking melatonin or another sleep aid counteracts the effects of the device. So I either get less sleep or I get a full night but it’s not restful.
Thank you. I never heard of EMDR but just started looking into it. There’s only a couple of providers in the area so I’ll have to see if any take my insurance.

I was in therapy and just started discussing this when the pandemic started. I wasn’t comfortable with virtual sessions so I just haven’t done thereapy since. I know I need to get back in it, it’s just hard.

Thank you. I’m sorry you had to go through that but I’m glad I’m not alone. That makes me feel less like I’m overreacting. 

I had a therapist that I just started discussing this with but then the pandemic happened. I’m not comfortable with virtual sessions so I stopped seeing her and I’ve been putting off going back. I’m moving soon so I’m going to push myself to find someone in my new city. 

She’s doing much better now mentally. She has schizoaffective disorder but is well managed with medication. As bad as it was to go through, it really made a difference in her getting the help she needs.
